criteria.requirement: Add Path.relative_beneath(base), normalizing absolute lexical paths then requiring commonpath containment and returning relative Path of the caller class. Same path returns "."; sibling prefix collisions and normalized .. escapes reject with ValueError, including cross-drive errors from the path module. Do no filesystem reads, symlink resolution or existence checks. Preserve original relpath and clearly distinguish this lexical operation from a symlink-safe containment/security boundary.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
